tutorial.scrollDownBody: Find Unplaced Buildings, then press Place on Map.
tutorial.returnToMapBody: Go back to the main map and click your building.
tutorial.buyBuildingBody: Pick the first farm building and buy it.
tutorial.marketTutorialBody: Pick a product, look at bids and asks, then try a small order. Prices are for you to discover.
tutorial.startHereBody: Open Build first. Your farm needs one building before anything can grow.
tutorial.placeItHereBody: Click an open spot on the map to drop the building.
tutorial.backToBuildBody: Open Build and press Place on Map for the building you bought.
tutorial.collectItBody: Click the green Collect button. After the first collect, the farm loop is yours.
tutorial.waitForYieldBody: Production is running. When a collect amount appears, take the partial harvest.
tutorial.setProductionBody: Enter a quantity, then click Start.
tutorial.openBuildingBody: Click your building on the map to start production.
tutorial.collectNowBody: {{count}} goods are ready. Collect them while production keeps going.
tutorial.watchProductionBody: Buildings produce over time. When the badge appears, collect the partial harvest.
tutorial.congratulationsBody: Your farm is running! Harvest complete. New areas of the game are now unlocked.

chapter1.chapter-title: Chapter One: Arrival at the Fief
chapter1.intro-bells: On a rainy night, the bells of the royal capital struck twelve.
chapter1.intro-crest: Your family crest was taken down from the council hall wall. The old nobles watched coldly, while trade guild delegates laughed under their breath.
chapter1.intro-mist: "New Haven? A fief swallowed by sea fog dares call itself a domain?"
chapter1.intro-contract: You stood outside the door, clutching the sailing contract your father left behind.
chapter1.intro-assets: It was a yellowed piece of parchment listing your family's last assets: an abandoned harbor, a stretch of barren land, and a few trade routes nearly cut off from the world.
chapter1.intro-last-words: But before he died, your father left only one sentence: "Do not look back. Go to New Haven. That is where our family truly begins."
chapter1.intro-boat: Before dawn, you boarded a worn little boat.
chapter1.intro-owner: The lights of the royal capital faded behind you. At the edge of the horizon, a forgotten harbor waited for its new master.
chapter1.arrival-boat: The worn little boat slowly drew alongside the dock.
chapter1.arrival-cloak: The sea breeze lifted your faded noble cloak. This was the fief you had inherited.
chapter1.cecil-shadow: Young Lord, welcome back to your fief. Though it holds only barren fields, an old warehouse, and a few trade roads no one dares travel... it still belongs to your family.
chapter1.cecil-reveal: The late lord entrusted me to support you, and to serve as your guardian. My name is Cecil Ashwing. Welcome to New Haven.
chapter1.choice-doubtA: No one believes in this place?
chapter1.doubt-a: Yes. The people in the capital all say this fief has no value left.
chapter1.doubt-b-complex: Young Lord, please do not make our guardianship so complicated on the first day of our family revival.
chapter1.doubt-b-vow: However... if that is your command, I shall guard you in the name of Ashwing until the stars fall into the sea and the royal banner returns.
chapter1.narrator-smile: You smiled softly and looked toward the silent harbor in the distance.
chapter1.young-ambition: If no one is fighting for it, then this is exactly where I can make my mark.
chapter1.choice-cecilA: Then I'll be counting on you, Lady Cecil.
chapter1.choice-cecilB: Then I'll be counting on you, Little Ash.
chapter1.cecil-a: As you command, Young Lord. From this day forth, I will assist you in rebuilding the fief.
chapter1.cecil-b-name: ...We can discuss forms of address another time.
chapter1.cecil-b-record: But if this is the command of New Haven's future ruler, I will remember it.
chapter1.young-richest: Starting today, this place will become the richest land in the kingdom once again.
chapter1.system-objective: New Tutorial Objective Unlocked: Repair the old dock and rebuild your first warehouse.
